references.text: The whole mountain of Sinai was wrapped in smoke because the Lord descended on it in fire. The smoke rose like the smoke from a furnace, and the whole mountain trembled violently.

When the people heard the thunder and the sound of the trumpet, saw the lightning flashes and the mountain covered in smoke, they were terrified and shook with fear. They kept their distance and said to Moses, 'Speak to us yourself, and we will listen; but do not let God speak to us, or we will die!'

They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something like a pavement made of sapphire, clear as the sky itself. But he did not raise his hand against the leaders of Israel. They beheld God, and they ate and drank.

Be very careful! For you saw no form on the day the Lord spoke to you at Horeb out of the fire. Therefore watch yourselves carefully so that you do not act corruptly and make an idol for yourselves in any shape or form.

Has any people ever heard the voice of God speaking out of the fire, as you have heard, and yet lived? The Lord let you hear his voice from heaven to teach you, and on earth he showed you his great fire.
Face to face the Lord spoke with you on the mountain, out of the fire. At that time I stood between the Lord and you to declare to you the word of the Lord, because you were afraid of the fire.

These words the Lord spoke out of the fire, the cloud, and the deep darkness with a loud voice to your entire assembly on the mountain. The people feared for their lives because they heard God's voice coming from the fire.
Elijah heard that the Lord was passing by, but the Lord was not in the wind, the earthquake, or the fire. After them came a still, small whisper.
No one has ever seen God. The only Son, who is himself God and is at the Father's side, he has made him known.
And the Father who sent me has himself borne witness about me. You have never heard his voice or seen his form.
You have not come to a mountain that can be touched, with blazing fire, darkness, gloom, and storm, with the sound of a trumpet and a voice speaking words.
